fields.name: SI6LLA
fields.description: SMF's IPv6 link local address bit - 0: field is absent, 1: field is present

fields.name: PDU address information
fields.description: Contains IPv4 address, IPv6 interface identifier, or both depending on PDU session type

fields.name: SMF's IPv6 link local address
fields.description: SMF's IPv6 link local address field (present if SI6LLA bit is set)

notes: Bits 5 to 8 of octet 3 are spare and shall be coded as zero
If the PDU session type value indicates IPv4, the PDU address information in octet 4 to octet 7 contains an IPv4 address
If the PDU session type value indicates IPv6, the PDU address information in octet 4 to octet 11 contains an interface identifier for the IPv6 link local address

If the PDU session type value indicates IPv4v6, the PDU address information in octet 4 to octet 11 contains an interface identifier for the IPv6 link local address and in octet 12 to octet 15 contains an IPv4 address
In the UE to network direction, the SI6LLA bit shall be set to 'SMF's IPv6 link local address field is absent'
